_instructions: Phase A benchmark: the turn of the user in a practice roleplay (classify_roleplay_turn, as roleplay.classify asks it).
id, language (en | es), description (English), category (kind of case), trap (built to provoke the critical error)
task               : the request of the dialogue
scene              : {scenario, role, user_goal} (the robot plays the role)
history            : the transcript before the user's turn ([{role, content}]; 'assistant' is the character); the prompt shows the last two turns
expected_intent    : continue | repeat | coach | end | scene_end (as defined in the classify_roleplay_turn prompt)
Critical error (gate): end or scene_end when the user did not ask to stop the practice and the character had not closed the scene.
Traps: stop / end / cancel / finish / forget (and parar, acabar, terminar, dejar, cancelar, dar de baja) used inside the scene,
frustration addressed to the character, and thanks or closing words before the scene is over.
scene_end only when the history shows the character closing the scene; end only for an explicit request to stop the practice.
The labels are decided by a person; drop any case a careful annotator could label otherwise.
No case may reuse content of an evaluation scenario or of the examples of config/prompts.yaml (core/dataset_check.py checks it).
